name: swu-deck-builder
description: A local-first Star Wars: Unlimited deck builder.
author: SWU Deck Builder contributors

scripts.predev: npm run env:configure && npm run catalog:ensure && npm run icons:build
scripts.prebuild: npm run catalog:ensure && npm run icons:build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:runtime
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json

scriptsInfo.postinstall: Configure the local environment after installing dependencies.
scriptsInfo.help: List every npm command and its purpose.

scriptsInfo.predev: Prepare the environment, catalog, and icons for development.
scriptsInfo.dev: Start the API and Vite development servers together.
scriptsInfo.dev:web: Start only the Vite development server.
scriptsInfo.dev:server: Start only the API server in watch mode.
scriptsInfo.prestart: Ensure a usable catalog exists before starting the server.
scriptsInfo.prebuild: Ensure the catalog and icons are ready for a web build.

scriptsInfo.build:web: Build the production web application with Vite.
scriptsInfo.build:runtime: Compile the server and desktop TypeScript runtimes.
scriptsInfo.typecheck: Check TypeScript across browser, Node, and test runtimes.
scriptsInfo.pretest: Regenerate icon assets before running tests.

scriptsInfo.preview: Serve the production build locally with Vite.

scriptsInfo.catalog:sync: Download selected missing sets from the private card source.
